command: sh byte-search-focused.sh (recorded command list in libc-byte-search-contracts.md)
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
: "${PYTHON:?select the interpreter}"
export PYTHON
bmake MACHINE=rp2040 check-libc-byte-search check-libc-array-memory-line \
    check-libc-aout-contracts check-board-libc-output check-string-header-contracts \
    check-c17-headers-cross check-c17-smaller-c check-c17-source-denominator \
    check-test-execution check-dpucp-profile check-changed-text check-changed-comments \
    CHANGED_COMMENT_BASE=cfe41205235bfc677e6fdf1a53a395aae2f6cb71 \
    CHANGED_COMMENT_HEAD=HEAD
"$PYTHON" tests/libc_contracts/byte_search.py . arm-none-eabi-gcc --arm --calibrate
clang-tidy -quiet -checks='-*,clang-analyzer-core.*,clang-analyzer-unix.*' \
    -warnings-as-errors='*' lib/libc/string/memmem.c lib/libc/compat/memchr.c \
    -- -target arm-none-eabi -mcpu=cortex-m0plus -mthumb -std=c17 -nostdinc -Iinclude
